A '''master traffic relayer''' was  system for managing traffic. One such system was in operation on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="Tempest Feud">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref> during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the [[Suwantek Systems|Suwantek]] [[TL-1200 transport]] ''[[New Ambition]]''<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> arrived at Nar Shaddaa and its [[Computer/Legends|computer]] interfaced with the moon's master traffic relayer.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
